name: shoppy
description: Handles domestic supplies end to end: quotes a price, holds until you confirm, places the order and follows the delivery. Prompts arrive around midday and evening meals with a cart summary each morning, so it runs on a fixed rhythm rather than whenever you feel like shopping.
